title: Keep a committed task-sync push start's dispatch when the managed custody fence fails after commit
outcome: Keep a committed task-sync push start's dispatch when the managed custody fence fails after commit
acceptance: When fence_managed_custody fails after the producing-origin effect has committed (a recover_pending_journal rename or sync failure, or a non-contention lock failure), the caller still gets the committed result and a first PushStarted is still dispatched once; a test injects that failure after commit and observes the dispatch
